svg.aria-label: Animation: one task moving through Quorum's stages, from bootstrap to the human gate. Plan review catches a duplicated helper before any code; the review loop sends a bug back to the builder, and the blind test sends a blocker back to the review loop, before the task reaches the human gate.
svg.text: Bootstrap
Spec & eval
Plan
Build
Review loop
Security + blind
Codify
Human gate
sent back
sent back
Step 1 of 12: init-pipeline: Makefile found; lint and test become the fast checks
Step 2 of 12: spec-and-eval: MEDIUM, a new command; research, rd.md, eval.md, two spec reviewers
Step 3 of 12: plan: the pattern auditor finds the plan's new loader duplicates load(); revised and approved
Step 4 of 12: build: the builder follows plan.md on feat/csv-export; the prover records passing checks
Step 5 of 12: review round 1: the logic reviewer finds export ignores DATA_FILE; the voter keeps it
Step 6 of 12: the builder fixes every place that ignores DATA_FILE; the checks pass again
Step 7 of 12: review round 2 reads only the fix: nothing IMPORTANT left, converged
Step 8 of 12: blind test: exporting "Acme, Inc." splits the row in two; a blocker
Step 9 of 12: the review loop fixes the blocker first, then reviews the fix: converged
Step 10 of 12: blind test, run 2: the goal is reached; friction is triaged into follow-ups
Step 11 of 12: codify-lesson: "All CSV output goes through csv.writer" joins REVIEW.md
Step 12 of 12: human gate: proof, rollback plan, and a PR description; waiting for your review
Teal: the stage passed · Red: a stage caught a problem and sent the work back
